desc: negative: opt=plain cmd=ng:mdb:batch:sticky-vid-duparg: the first vid is still set, so the second line is a duparg, which exits 255 through -force (M3)
pre: ip link add br0 address 02:00:00:00:01:00 type bridge vlan_filtering 1 && ip link set br0 addrgenmode none && ip link set br0 type bridge mcast_igmp_version 3 mcast_mld_version 2 && echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv6/conf/br0/disable_ipv6

ip link add d1 address 02:00:00:00:01:01 type dummy && ip link set d1 addrgenmode none && ip link set d1 master br0 && ip link set d1 up && ip link add d2 address 02:00:00:00:01:02 type dummy && ip link set d2 addrgenmode none && ip link set d2 master br0 && ip link set d2 up && ip link set br0 up
bridge vlan add dev d1 vid 10 && bridge vlan add dev d2 vid 10 && bridge vlan add dev br0 vid 10 self
bridge mdb add dev br0 port d1 grp 239.1.1.1 permanent vid 10
bridge mdb add dev br0 port d2 grp ff0e::1 temp
bridge mdb add dev br0 port d1 grp 239.2.2.2 permanent filter_mode include source_list 10.0.0.1,10.0.0.2 proto static
bridge mdb add dev br0 port d2 grp 232.1.1.1 src 10.0.0.1 permanent
bridge mdb add dev br0 port d2 grp 01:02:03:04:05:06 permanent
bridge mdb add dev br0 port br0 grp 239.3.3.3 temp
bridge link set dev d1 mcast_router 2
printf '%s\n' 'mdb show vid 10' 'mdb show vid 10' > b.txt
